NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE 1 ZONING MAP AMENDMENT APPLICATION

Applicant: Humbolt Park Health

Property Location: 1140 N California Ave, Chicago IL, 60622
Proposed Zoning: B3-3 Community Shopping District

Lot Area: 6,118 square feet

Humboldt Park Health is the “Applicant” for a Type 1 Zoning Map Amendment for the subject
property located at 1140 N Califomia Ave, Chicago IL, 60622. The Applicant requests a re-zoning
from the B3-1 Community Shopping District to the B3-3 Community Shopping District to build a
new, 3-story outpatient behavioral health clinic, urgent care center, and medical office. The floor
area will be 17,060 square feet and building height at 45 feet, with no off-street parking. A Transit-
Served Location Parking Reduction is proposed. The subject property is less than 1,320 feet from
the Division CTA Bus Corridor.

The site is bounded by North Califomia Avenue; the public alley south of and parallel to West
Division Street; the public alley west of and parallel to North California Avenue, and a line 48.75
feet south of and parallel to the public alley south of and parallel West Division Street. To the north
are properties zoned B3-3, to the south are properties zoned B3-1, to the east are properties zoned
B3-2, and to the west are properties zoned RS-3.
